rv.q: The proceedings have the veneer of a Black Mirror episode, and there are a few truly disturbing images, but the premise didn’t blow my mind like the best episodes of the show have, or even leave me with much to chew on.
It’s a technically impressive and diverting lark that combines elements of dystopian video game, escape room, and interactive theme park ride.

cn.t: This technically impressive but uneven immersive experience blurs the line between theater and interactive entertainment, offering a diverting dystopian blend of escape room and VR that doesn't fully deliver on its premise.
